name: Group formed on La Banda
detail: Formed at the finale of season 1 on Univision, December 13, with a five-year Sony Music Latin deal and Ricky Martin as representative

name: First concert
detail: The Fillmore Miami Beach

name: Ricky Martin One World Tour
detail: Opening act on U.S. and South American dates from February 12

name: Yankee Stadium
detail: Sang the national anthem in May

name: Más Allá Tour
detail: First headlining tour, from February 26 in Cochabamba: 15 countries, 40 performances

name: Ariana Grande Dangerous Woman Tour
detail: Opening act

name: Enrique Iglesias and Pitbull Live
detail: Opening act; the Chicago opener was reported in June

name: New management
detail: Signed with Walter Kolm Entertainment on May 16 after almost three years with Ricky Martin

name: CNCO World Tour
detail: Began in Guatemala and included their first U.S. dates. The source's tour list dates it 2019

name: Press Start Tour
detail: Announced January 21; planned for May 30 to June 21, then postponed because of the pandemic. The source's tour list calls it cancelled

name: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
detail: Performed Mis Ojos Lloran por Ti on November 26

name: Joel Pimentel leaves
detail: Announced his exit on May 9; the group continues as a quartet

name: Last concert as five
detail: Déjà Vu Global Streaming, May 14

name: Toa La Noche: Club Tour
detail: Listed in the source's tour list

name: Disney+ acting debut announced
detail: Announced February 3 for the miniseries 4Ever

name: Tini Tour 2022
detail: Opened the Quito show

name: Breakup announced
detail: Zabdiel De Jesús announced at Premios Juventud (July 21) that the group would end in about a year and a half

name: La Última Cita Tour
detail: Farewell tour announced March 7; began May 9 in La Paz, Bolivia

name: 4Ever premieres
detail: Disney+ miniseries starring the group, October 11

name: Final show and disbandment
detail: Last concert in Puerto Rico, November 17, with their families present
